name: CRAVE Mediterranean Grill
notes: 4 photos, all menus: a tri-fold catering brochure (2 photos) and two TV digital menu boards showing the same core Crave Originals menu. Wrap/sandwich items and prices matched across the tri-fold and the TV board. Salad prices differed between the tri-fold ($12 each) and the TV board ($10 each); used the TV board price as it is clearer and non-rotated. Build-your-own bowl/wrap/pita step options and per-protein salad add-ons were skipped as modifiers.
